about: The writes of the fast path's switch (docs/design/fast-admission-widening.md, sections 5.5 and 5.6), which Go embeds (fastpath.SwitchStatementsV1, executed by internal/switchsql for Store.SetWorkspace) and the enabler reads, so the columns, the values and the revocation cannot drift. Each operation is one read-write transaction: its mutations buffered and its statements executed in order, each statement's row count reported under its counts name. A value "@name" is the parameter name, "@commit_timestamp" the transaction's commit timestamp. disable is the store's: the switch, the revocation and a hold with the caller's reason. disable_unheld is the same without the hold, and only the enabler's own disable reads it; Go has no unheld disable.

statements.sql: UPDATE tr_lease SET revoked = TRUE, revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE workspace_id = @workspace AND state = 'open' AND NOT revoked
